item.title: The Last Dry Seat

turns.text: Make a silent 15-second widescreen short in three scenes. A young woman with a curly black bob and yellow raincoat finds a wet park bench. An older man with a white beard and blue coat offers his folded newspaper to sit on. They sit together and smile. Live-action look, sweet rather than cheesy.

item.tests: Turns two described characters and a simple story into one assembled 15-second film with a readable setup, kind gesture and resolution.

answer_sheet.Characters: A young adult woman with a curly black bob and yellow raincoat; an older adult man with a white beard and blue coat.
answer_sheet.Story and setting: A wet park bench; the woman finds it wet, the man offers his folded newspaper as a dry seat, then they sit together and smile.
answer_sheet.Length and format: One 15-second widescreen 16:9 video, with three scenes.
answer_sheet.Sound, dialogue and text: Silent, with no dialogue, captions or titles.

must_haves: One playable 15-second widescreen film contains three sequential scenes, not separate clip deliverables.
The woman has a curly black bob and yellow raincoat; the man has a white beard and blue coat.
The opening visibly establishes that the park bench is wet.
The man offers a folded newspaper as a dry place to sit, and the ending shows both characters seated together and smiling.
The film has a live-action appearance and no audible soundtrack.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a silent 15-second live-action short film in widescreen, exactly three sequential scenes with simple clean cuts, grounded natural performances and consistent characters, wardrobe and park location throughout. Photorealistic cinema, soft overcast daylight just after rain, muted green park and natural skin texture. Young adult woman with a curly black bob and a yellow raincoat; older adult man with a white beard and a blue coat. SCENE 1, seconds 0-5: medium-wide eye-level view of a quiet park bench, visibly wet with rain droplets. The woman approaches, notices the wet seat and pauses with a small, matter-of-fact look of disappointment. The man stands nearby at the other end of the bench holding a folded newspaper. SCENE 2, seconds 5-10: medium two-shot of the same people and bench. The man gently offers her his folded newspaper, extending it toward her with an understated friendly expression. She accepts it, gives a small grateful nod and lays it flat on the wet bench as a dry place to sit. Clearly show the newspaper transfer, with natural hands and physically coherent motion. SCENE 3, seconds 10-15: settled medium-wide two-shot. She sits on the folded newspaper and he sits beside her, leaving a comfortable respectful space. They briefly exchange small genuine smiles, then settle quietly looking out at the park. Sweet, restrained, observational and human, never cheesy or sentimental. Mostly static camera, subtle cinematic framing. No romance, hugging, dramatic gestures, broad grins, slow motion or emotional advertising style. No captions, title cards, logos or text overlays. Absolutely silent: no speech, music, sound effects or ambient audio.
